findings.title: Two different operational definitions of PDAC essentiality coexist
findings.detail: E1/E3/E3-A use depmap_pdac_dependency.json['essential'] (4584 genes) while E2 is derived from pdac_selective_dependency_v11.json['pan_essential'] (4585 genes); Jaccard = 0.942. V17 mixed the two without comment.
findings.action: Declare both definitions in Methods and report the Jaccard overlap, or harmonise on one source. Keep E2 explicitly labelled as PSD-derived.

findings.title: E3-A is numerically identical to E1
findings.detail: E3-A was defined as 'essential(gene)' and E1 as 'essential(gene)'. The two label vectors are bit-identical (n_pos=4584), so every one of the 12 methods reports the same AUROC in both columns of the V17 benchmark. V17 presented them as two of 'seven endpoints', which a referee can falsify in seconds from v17_ncs_results.json.
findings.action: Report six operationally independent endpoints and state explicitly that E3-A is E1 by construction: removing the druggability conjunct from E3 collapses the positive set onto E1. This strengthens the negative result rather than weakening it.

findings.title: E2 is nested within E1, not an independent endpoint
findings.detail: 1099/1147 (95.8%) of E2 positives are also E1 positives; E2 is defined as the top quartile of PDAC-selective effect *among pan-essential genes*.
findings.action: Describe E2 as a stratification of E1, never as independent validation.

findings.title: GDSC drug-response endpoint constructed
findings.detail: 29 PDAC lines, 125 drugs, 32 positive target genes.
findings.action: Add E6 as the only endpoint with a pharmacological readout; keep therapeutic claims strictly bounded to cell-line sensitivity.

findings.title: Harmonic mean code is correct; Methods text is a typo
findings.detail: run_v17_ncs.py:ecs_harmonic computes 2(D+3)(PHI+3)/((D+3)+(PHI+3)), which is algebraically identical to the standard 2(D+3)(PHI+3)/(D+PHI+6) (max |deviation| = 4.44e-16 over all 20751 genes). The printed Methods formula '2*D*(PHI+3)/(D+3+PHI+3)' dropped the +3 shift in the numerator.
findings.action: Correct one sentence in Methods. Do NOT re-run or re-draw anything for P0-1.

findings.title: Cancer-driver single-layer scorer was never computed in V17
findings.detail: V17 Results quote 'cancer-driver annotation at 0.524' but v17_ncs_results.json contains no cancer_driver scorer; 0.524 is the E1 value of genetic constraint. The number was mis-attributed.
findings.action: Compute the cancer-driver layer explicitly (done here) and requote.

findings.title: V17 Results quoted E3 numbers while describing the E1 endpoint
findings.detail: V17 line: '4,585 essential genes ... mutation frequency achieved AUROC 0.520 (95% CI 0.506-0.536), genetic constraint 0.559'. Those are the E3 (actionability) values. On the endpoint actually described (E1 essentiality) the true values are mutation 0.499 [0.490-0.508] and constraint 0.524 [0.516-0.533].
findings.action: Requote the E1 values; they are the ones whose CI actually brackets 0.5.

findings.title: 'DeLong p > 0.05 against AUROC = 0.5' is not a valid test and was never run
findings.detail: DeLong compares two correlated empirical ROC curves; it cannot test a single curve against the 0.5 null, and run_v17_ncs.py contains no such test (its only DeLong call is ECS vs STRING on E3). Replaced by Mann-Whitney U, which is exactly equivalent to the AUROC = 0.5 null: on E1, mutation frequency p = 0.836, genetic constraint p = 4.29e-07, druggability p = 0.0503.
findings.action: State CI overlap with 0.5 and Mann-Whitney U; delete the DeLong-vs-0.5 sentence.

findings.title: 'Random forest strongest on 5 of 6 endpoints' needs restating
findings.detail: E1 -> Random forest 0.750; E2 -> Random forest 0.631; E3 -> Random forest 0.943; E3-A -> Random forest 0.750; E3-C -> Druggability 1.000 (tie); E4 -> Random forest 0.756; E5 -> STRING centrality 0.986; E6 -> Random forest 0.913
findings.action: Quote the per-endpoint winner exactly, noting the E3-C ties at 1.0 are pure leakage.

findings.title: E3-C is fully saturated for any method that ingests druggability
findings.detail: Druggability, Logistic regression, Elastic net, Random forest reach AUROC = 1.000 on E3-C because druggability is simultaneously an input feature and the label. STRING alone reaches 0.620 [0.611-0.629], which is above chance, not 'near-chance' as V17 states.
findings.action: Restrict E3-C to leakage-free scorers (STRING, ECS-minus-druggability) and drop the 'near-chance' wording for STRING.

findings.title: V17 reported E3 functional-form values as if they were clinical-endpoint values
findings.detail: V17: 'the same ordering holds on E6 (harmonic 0.941, additive 0.825, geometric 0.758, multiplicative 0.825, rank 0.854)'. additive 0.825 and geometric 0.758 are the E3 numbers. Recomputed on the clinical endpoint: harmonic 0.941, additive 0.948, geometric 0.913, multiplicative 0.825, rank 0.854 (E3 for reference: harmonic 0.893, additive 0.825, geometric 0.758).
findings.action: Use the recomputed clinical-endpoint values; re-draw Fig. 4b.

findings.title: Weight-space result is far more damaging than V17 stated
findings.detail: Mean AUROC over 1,000 Dirichlet weightings is 0.335 with 91.3% of draws BELOW chance (0.5); only 2.6% beat STRING alone (0.738). V17 reported only the 3.6% figure and omitted that the average weighting is anti-predictive.
findings.action: Report mean, the sub-chance fraction, and the 3.6% figure together.

findings.title: Replacing a real evidence layer with Gaussian noise IMPROVES the heuristic
findings.detail: ECS on E3 = 0.693; replacing the tissue-specificity layer with N(0,1) noise gives 0.780. The multiplicative heuristic is therefore not extracting signal from that layer at all.
findings.action: Foreground this control: it is the strongest single piece of evidence for the paper's central negative claim.

findings.title: The 9 candidates were not ordered by harmonic mean as the manuscript claims
findings.detail: V17 Fig. 6b legend states 'ranked by harmonic mean'. The printed order is KPNA2, ARF6, RAB7A, ITGA2B, GNG2, STAMBP, RAB6A, F3, TNFRSF8; the true harmonic-mean order is KPNA2, STAMBP, ARF6, RAB7A, GNG2, RAB6A, F3, ITGA2B, TNFRSF8. The printed order came from an external file (SCI论文的LJT/results/tvs_analysis.json) and is not reproducible from run_v17_ncs.py.
findings.action: Use the recomputed ordering, generate the table inside the pipeline, and label the genes as prospective computational hypotheses, not validated targets.

findings.title: Candidate essentiality status must be disclosed
findings.detail: 9/9 candidates are PDAC-essential in DepMap; 8/9 are CRC-essential.
findings.action: State essentiality status per candidate in the display item.

p0_1_harmonic_verification.verdict: The V17 CODE implements the standard harmonic mean exactly (max deviation 4.44e-16). The V17 METHODS TEXT is a typesetting error: the numerator lost its '+3' shift. No numerical result changes.
